goal: perform bounded real mutations only inside a disposable detached Git worktree and export a patch after deterministic gates pass
gates: ready handoff mutates a disposable detached worktree and exports an applicable patch while main source bytes stay unchanged
replace_ast structurally matches syntax despite formatting trivia and remains bounded by Scout evidence
partial/blocked or stale Scout handoffs never create write authority
files outside the Scout handoff cannot enter the mutation
a touched file whose detached HEAD baseline differs from the Scout fingerprint is rejected
syntax failure after worktree mutation exports no patch and the worktree is removed
failed deterministic postconditions export no patch and the worktree is removed
patches above 120 changed lines are rejected
every success/failure path leaves no additional Git worktree behind
